title: SOP Lifecycle Management: Creation, Review, Retirement
purpose: Prevents SOP proliferation by defining when SOPs should be created, updated, and retired. With 13 existing SOPs + 3 new ones from this analysis, the system is near saturation. This SOP governs the lifecycle of all other SOPs.

section_1_creation_criteria.title: When to Create a New SOP
section_1_creation_criteria.gate: ALL of these must be true before creating a new SOP:

criteria.test: Can you point to a specific, documented incident where the existing SOPs were insufficient?
criteria.evidence_required: Team session log describing the failure and what SOP would have prevented it

criteria.test: Has this failure mode occurred in 2+ team sessions?
criteria.evidence_required: References to multiple team session logs

criteria.criterion: Not coverable by updating an existing SOP
criteria.test: Could a v2 of an existing SOP address this?
criteria.action: If yes, update the existing SOP instead of creating a new one

criteria.test: Is this SOP about domain work or does it pass SOP-023 FREEZE-01?
criteria.action: Infrastructure SOPs require documented novel failure mode

section_2_review_schedule.title: SOP Review and Update
section_2_review_schedule.schedule: After every 5 team sessions (e.g., after T33, T38, T43...)
review_process: 1. List all SOPs with last-used date
2. For each SOP: was it referenced or followed in any of the last 5 sessions?
3. SOPs not referenced in 10+ sessions → candidate for retirement
4. SOPs referenced but not followed → needs simplification or enforcement
5. SOPs referenced and followed → keep as-is
6. SOPs with v2 updates → archive v1, promote v2 as primary

criteria.criterion: Superseded by a newer SOP or v2 update
criteria.action: Archive original, keep only the latest version
Merge into the more comprehensive SOP, archive the smaller one
criteria.current_candidates: SOP-014 overlaps with SOP-011 — consider merging
